presentation.label: MUTE LATCH
presentation.summary: Press PERFORM while choosing tracks in PREP MUTES and the mutes wait for the pattern's first step.
presentation.overview: PREP MUTES normally mutes the chosen tracks the moment FUNC is let go. With Mute Latch, pressing PERFORM while FUNC is held and tracks are chosen parks the choice instead: let go of every key and the mutes switch at the next pass of the pattern's first step, so both hands are free for a synth or effects in the meantime. Without a choice or without the pattern playing, PERFORM keeps its stock the stock PERFORM sub-function, and PREP MUTES works exactly as before.
highlights: Parks the PREP MUTES choice until the pattern starts again
Takes only the PERFORM key press inside an open PREP MUTES session while the pattern plays
Takes no sequencer hook: it follows the instrument's own step position
usage: Play a pattern, enter Mute Mode (FUNC+TRK), hold FUNC, press the TRIG keys of the tracks to switch, press PERFORM, then let go of all keys; the tracks switch at the next first step.

steps: Start the sequencer with PLAY and enter Mute Mode (FUNC+TRK).
Hold FUNC to open PREP MUTES and press the TRIG keys of the tracks to switch; press a key again to take the track back out.
Press PERFORM while still holding FUNC. The choice is parked and the stock PERFORM sub-function does not open.
Let go of every key. The tracks switch when the pattern next reaches its first step.
Press PERFORM again with nothing chosen to cancel what is parked; STOP also drops it.

limitations: Not tested on a unit. Tested only by driving the stock OS 1.17 image in a ColdFire-only emulator; see TESTING.md.
Works while the sequencer plays; when it is stopped PREP MUTES keeps its stock behaviour.
With Scale per track the longest track's wrap ends the pattern.
Switches on the first UI tick (about 30 Hz) after the pattern wraps, not sample-accurately.
FUNC+PERFORM opens a stock view over PREP MUTES: while PREP MUTES is open, tracks are chosen and the pattern plays, the module takes that key press, so that stock sub-function is not available then.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.
